svg.title: F — Low housing and service sides
svg.desc: Original proposals for detached, semi-detached and attached houses. Shared scale, different access and roofs.
svg.text: F / Low housing: a house, a pair, a range
PROPOSALS · all plan and elevation dimensions in metres · 12 px/m · no measured occupancy asserted
Detached / postwar family
Front entry / service rooms; garden living side.
Rear / garden elevation
Garden doors; gutters and downpipes at ends.
Semi-detached / two entries
Front entry / service rooms; garden living side.
Rear / garden elevation
Garden doors; gutters and downpipes at ends.
Attached / four-house range
Front entry / service rooms; garden living side.
Rear / garden elevation
Garden doors; gutters and downpipes at ends.
DK2 supports front/garden asymmetry and truss logic; US1/NL1 constrain paired/attached organisation. All sizes here are authored.
Domestic modules cannot be multiplied inside one game Building without deciding how architectural homes map to tenancies.
